headline: Mustek Revenue Rises as Memory Chip Shortage Elevates PC Prices
summary: JSE-listed technology distributor Mustek reported higher revenue as a global memory-chip shortage drove up personal computer prices despite falling sales volumes.

impacts.name: Mustek
impacts.why: Higher average selling prices for tech hardware offset lower unit sales volumes, boosting total revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
